sources.title: Johnson & Johnson, Form 10-K for fiscal year 2021 (Executive officers of the registrant)
sources.excerpt: Mr. J. Duato became Chief Executive Officer and Chairman of the Executive Committee and joined the Board of Directors in January 2022.

sources.title: Johnson & Johnson press release (Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1): CEO transition to Joaquin Duato
sources.excerpt: Mr. Alex Gorsky, currently Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, will serve as Executive Chairman of Johnson & Johnson and transition the Chief Executive Officer role to Mr. Joaquin Duato, currently Vice Chairman of the Company’s Executive Committee, effective January 3, 2022.

sources.title: Johnson & Johnson press release (Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1): CEO transition to Joaquin Duato
sources.excerpt: As a dual citizen of Spain and the United States, Mr. Duato’s international perspective and global lens gives him a deep appreciation of diverse thoughts and opinions.

sources.title: Johnson & Johnson Names CEO Joaquin Duato as Chairman of the Board (Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1)
sources.excerpt: Johnson & Johnson (NYSE: JNJ) today announced that its Board of Directors has elected Chief Executive Officer, Mr. Joaquin Duato, to assume the additional position of Chairman, effective in January 2023.

sources.title: Johnson & Johnson Names CEO Joaquin Duato as Chairman of the Board (Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1)
sources.excerpt: Mr. Duato has served as Johnson & Johnson’s CEO and a member of the Board of Directors since January 3, 2022.

sources.title: Joaquin Duato Named PhRMA Board Chairman (Johnson & Johnson press release)
sources.excerpt: Duato has served as worldwide chairman, pharmaceuticals at Johnson & Johnson since January 2011.

sources.title: Joaquin Duato Named PhRMA Board Chairman (Johnson & Johnson press release)
sources.excerpt: The Pharmaceutical Research and Manufacturers of America (PhRMA) today announced Joaquin Duato, worldwide chairman, pharmaceuticals, Johnson & Johnson, has been named chairman of PhRMA’s board of directors.

sources.title: Joaquin Duato Named PhRMA Board Chairman (Johnson & Johnson press release)
sources.excerpt: Duato holds an undergraduate degree in economics and business, a Masters of Business Administration from ESADE, Barcelona and a Masters of International Management from Thunderbird, Phoenix.
